projects.title: GAN-Based Data Augmentation for Imbalanced Datasets
points: \textbf{Custom GAN Architecture} --- Designed Generator ($128 \rightarrow 256 \rightarrow 512$, Tanh) and Discriminator ($512 \rightarrow 256 \rightarrow 128 \rightarrow 1$) networks with Xavier initialization, LeakyReLU activations and BatchNorm for stable tabular GAN training.

\textbf{Synthetic Data Generation Pipeline} --- Built an end-to-end augmentation framework using a custom GAN and SMOTE to address class imbalance in tabular datasets, using a credit-card dataset (10,000,000+ data points) as the use case.
\textbf{Multi-Model Training Framework} --- Trained Random Forest, XGBoost, LightGBM and Gradient Boosting on real vs. real+augmented data using 5-fold cross-validation.
\textbf{Performance Improvement} --- Brought False Negatives down to just 9 on a 10,000,000+ row dataset; recall increased from 0.91 to 0.99.
